game_title: And/Or Locks – Net Menders' Pier Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier, a pier of net menders: the deckhand must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – And/Or Locks: Combine conditions with and/or to open a lock that needs several clues.
theme: Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier: a pier of net menders
core_gameplay_loop: In Net Menders' Pier, repeat each round: Combine conditions with and/or to open a lock that needs several clues. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the deckhand ahead. Then check the lock_progress value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the harbor gate by solving code steps involving lock_progress that move the deckhand forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the harbor gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 6 (applied tier): And/Or Locks
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'And/Or Locks' (Week 3 slot 4), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Net Menders' Pier'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lock_progress changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Net Menders' Pier.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
